title: The Coral Reef Observatory
description: Promotion assumes a reviewed artifact version, scoped cross-account deployment role and explicit bucket/key permissions. The diagram does not demonstrate model quality, safety or scientific validity. SageMaker is shown as a regional managed service. Private inference access requires appropriate VPC endpoints and IAM/network configuration; training/inference infrastructure is not placed inside the review app’s AZ boxes. The internal ALB is reachable only through assumed corporate/private connectivity. App-level identity verification and reviewer authorization remain necessary. Task-token callbacks go through an authenticated backend. Only the successful approval branch publishes accepted records. Training data, predictions and accepted evidence have different retention/access policies. Training pipelines, endpoint HA settings, staff connectivity and complete audit infrastructure are omitted.

edges.meaning: Training role writes versioned model artifacts; accuracy is not established by this diagram.
Human-approved version is selected for promotion; S3 presence alone is not approval.
Approved deployment assumes a scoped cross-account role and explicit artifact/key permissions.
Configured S3 EventBridge rule starts execution; EventBridge node is omitted in this focused deployment view.
Workflow invokes the custom-trained endpoint through its execution role; VPC endpoints constrain service access.
Browser or corporate network presents identity to the review application; no public ALB is implied.
Private staff access reaches review tasks in AZ A through authorized network connectivity.
Independent task placement in AZ B; user identity is verified by the application.
Approved reviewer action uses an authenticated backend and task-token callback; token never becomes public authority.
Rejected results do not advance to publication; review policy and audit are required.
Only the successful human-approval branch invokes publication.
Writes accepted labels with provenance; predictions and raw objects remain separate.
